spec: bonded.quartic_bond, bonded.harmonic_bond, bonded.cosine_angle, bonded.harmonic_angle, bonded.dihedral_chebyshev, bonded.dihedral_new, bonded.improper_dihedral
generator: lake exe spec-vectors (NewenSpec.Bonded.quarticBondFloat, harmonicBondFloat, cosineAngleFloat, harmonicAngleFloat, dihedralChebyshevFloat, dihedralNewFloat, improperFloat; SplitMix64, fixed seed)
encoding: every float is the hex string of its IEEE 754 binary64 bits (f64::to_bits, Float.toBits); m is a float
layout_bonds: r (3), k_quartic, b0, k_harmonic; quartic_bond energy, f_i (3); harmonic_bond energy, f_i (3)
layout_angles: r_ij (3), r_kj (3), k_cosine, cos0, k_harmonic, theta0; cosine_angle energy, f_i, f_j, f_k (3 each); harmonic_angle energy, f_i, f_j, f_k
layout_dihedrals: r_ij (3), r_kj (3), r_kl (3), k, cos_delta, delta, m, k_improper, zeta0; dihedral_chebyshev(k, cos_delta, m) energy, f_i, f_j, f_k, f_l (3 each); dihedral_new(k, delta, m) energy, f_i, f_j, f_k, f_l; improper_dihedral(k_improper, zeta0) energy, f_i, f_j, f_k, f_l
